steps.name: Given I am on the HOME page
When I clock in the timesheet with PIN "4683"
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('4', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('6', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('8', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('3', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title') }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'CONFIRM', exact: true })
Then I should see the employee "Samantha" in the employee list
Then I should see the "Ticket View" screen
And I should see the "Manicure" service
When I add the "Manicure" service to my cart
Then I should see my cart showing 1 item added
When I click on the total price of "Manicure"
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
Click locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
When I pay the exact amount by "Cash"
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) })
Expect "toContainText" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogContent-root')
Expect "toContainText" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogContent-root')

Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'OK', exact: true })
Expect "toBeHidden" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) })
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
When I select the "CLOSED TICKET" tab
Then I should see the first ticket of payment "$23.50"
When I reopen ticket with payment amount "$23.50"

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$23.50' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first()

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$23.50' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()

Click locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$23.50' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()
Then I should see the "Ticket View" screen
And I should see the user info "Samantha" in the ticket
When I click on the "Pay" button
Then I should see the payment history "Cash $23.50" visible
When I select the payment history "Cash $23.50"
Then I should see a popup dialog with title "Cash  - $23.50"
When I click on the "Remove" button in the popup dialog
When I select the "Credit" payment type
And I fill the last 4 digits of card number "1234"
And I select the "VISA" on the menu
Then I should see the payment history "VISA (1234)$24.20" visible
